<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

This matters because incorrect permissions can block legitimate changes or allow unauthorized ones before payment triggers.\n\n## Who is affected\n- A large commercial insurer, Marrowgate Commercial, whose staff want to ensure roles are assigned correctly so only authorized staff can adjust reserves [i:8b9b09ae561d0188].\n- A cyber insurance customer, Ormsgill Cyber, whose staff are under the impression they have the right role but suspect a possible misconfiguration [i:f2b4bc4061ee48ca].\n- A fleet mutual insurer, Harrowfield Fleet Mutual, whose staff are specifically concerned with how roles affect who can adjust reserves before payment triggers [i:f6f76c5dbb558280].\n\n## Evidence\nThe problem has been raised by 3 accounts in total, across 2 different routes [i:8b9b09ae561d0188][i:f2b4bc4061ee48ca][i:f6f76c5dbb558280]. Sales conversations have generated 2 of the 3 total mentions, and support conversations have generated 1 mention [i:8b9b09ae561d0188][i:f2b4bc4061ee48ca][i:f6f76c5dbb558280]. The combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of the accounts where ARR is known is £1,735,000.0 [i:8b9b09ae561d0188][i:f2b4bc4061ee48ca]. One of the affected accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12, and there has been 1 renewal across all accounts in the last 90 days [i:8b9b09ae561d0188].\n\n## Why now\nThe issue is active and unresolved, with the most recent mention occurring on 2026-10-28 [i:f2b4bc4061ee48ca]. The concern spans different types of insurance customers (commercial, cyber, fleet) and has been raised in both sales and support contexts, indicating it is a cross-functional and ongoing point of confusion. With a key account, Marrowgate Commercial, renewing on 2026-12-12, clarity on role configuration is a timely concern [i:8b9b09ae561d0188].",
